decisions.reason: Naval vessel lighting involves substantial engineering, certification and long-term defense customer commitments, so the sunk investment and contractual obligations make withdrawal unlikely.
The desk lamp has its own dedicated page, which signals visible commitment and fits the ergonomic workplace positioning, so management would attribute any weak sales to temporary market softness.

This second-generation interior luminaire was publicly announced as newly arrived and sits at the core of the LED interior range, so dropping it would expose a recent, prominent decision as a mistake.
The microprismatic pendant is only mentioned rather than featured, but it supports the ergonomic, standards-compliant office lighting direction, so modest commitment still favors keeping it.
An HMI searchlight relies on discharge-lamp technology that conflicts with the announced LED direction, received little public commitment, and its weak prospects cannot be blamed on temporary causes.
The marine searchlight complements the specialist marine portfolio with certified engineering already invested, and it carries little justification burden to drop but adequate reason to persist.
